[[File:Oresources.jpg|thumb|Ore Processing Center]]
The '''Ore Processing Center''' was a type of building used for breaking down and smelting raw minerals into usable metals, usually [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. Generally found at mining outposts, [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droids]] or other miners extracting [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from ore deposits would bring carts of the precious raw metals back to these structures.

==Behind the scenes==
Ore Processing Centers serve as resource drop-off buildings in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
